title: Impact of Preschool Teachers on Recruitment and Centre Operations
what_it_is: Impact of Preschool Teachers on Recruitment and Centre Operations

sections.label: Preschool manpower growth projection
sections.summary: ECDA projects the sector manpower must grow by another 1,500 over the next two to three years to meet childcare needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: However, with the rapid expansion of preschool capacity and the tight labour market, more employers have told Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) that they have found it more challenging to fill staff vacancies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Hence, over the next two to three years, ECDA projects the sector manpower to have to grow by another 1,500 in order to meet the needs for childcare.

sections.label: ECDA professional development programmes
sections.summary: ECDA launched the Professional Development Programme and SkillsFuture Study Awards for the early childhood sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Last year, for example, ECDA launched the Professional Development Programme to equip educators with competencies needed for larger job roles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: More recently, ECDA launched the SkillsFuture Study Awards for the early childhood sector to support aspiring centre leaders.

sections.label: Childcare enrolment and localised shortages
sections.summary: Overall childcare enrolment rate is not at maximum, but there are localised shortages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: In terms of enrolment rate, so far, what we find from the childcare centres, the number of childcare places, when you aggregate them as a whole, the enrolment rate is not at maximum.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: But what you find is that there are localised shortages.

sections.label: PCP for childcare teachers
sections.summary: Those with tertiary qualifications can enrol in the 12 to 15 month PCP, with salary support at about 90% capped at $4,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Should they meet the requirements, we would be happy to take them in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Those who possess tertiary qualifications, they can enrol in the PCP for childcare teachers or kindergarten teachers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: It is an accelerated programme delivered over 12 to 15 months and the range of different support that is available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The salary support is at about 90% of the basic monthly salary, capped at $4,000.

sections.label: Adjusting requirements to expand numbers
sections.summary: Adjusting some requirements to expand the numbers who can come on board is something that would be considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: If, indeed, by adjusting some of the requirements, we could expand the numbers that can come on board, that is something that we would want to consider.
